reviews.comment:
Soy socio del ACÁ desde 1978 y es un Excelente lugar, yo cada vez que viajo, paro para estirar las piernas y además tomar unos mates a la sombra de los árboles que tienen. O comer y beber bebidas frías. Tienen descuentos para todos los socios, tanto para los combustibles y para consumo interno presentado el Carné de Socio. Baños impecable y atención de 10. Recomiendo al 100 por ciento.  👍👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

(Translated by Google)
I've been a member of ACA since 1978 and it's an excellent place. Every time I travel, I stop to stretch my legs and have some mate in the shade of their trees. Or I can eat and drink cold beverages. They offer discounts for all members, both on fuel and for food and drinks within the club, just show your membership card. The restrooms are spotless and the service is top-notch. I highly recommend it. 👍👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻
